name: Manager sees cost of goods; member_level policies UNION across groups
note:
Holds the member_level pilot on Orderfacts, and records behaviour the documentation does not state.

contextToGroups returns ['tenant_user', ...roles], so a manager belongs to BOTH the group that EXCLUDES cost/margin and the group that includes everything. The two policies UNION: the manager gets the real value. Had they intersected, the exclusion would have won and the manager policy would be useless - which is why this is asserted rather than assumed.

TWO LIMITATIONS FOUND BY MEASURING, both of which matter more than the feature:

1. A restricted user gets 0, NOT an error. linepricelimit returns 0 for a plain user and 3,080,145.81 for a manager over the same window. A dashboard renders 'COGS: 0', which is indistinguishable from a real zero. This is the same silent-wrongness shape as every other defect found in this model.

2. member_level does NOT hide members from /v1/meta. A restricted user still sees all 17 Orderfacts measures listed, so linepricelimit appears in Playground and BI field pickers and simply returns 0 when picked.

member_masking was tried as a remedy and made it worse: adding mask.sql plus member_masking dropped the MANAGER to 0 as well, removing access that worked. Reverted.
referenceSql: SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN charat(dt.docbasetype::character varying,3)::text='C' THEN (ol.pricelimit*-1)*ol.QtyOrdered ELSE ol.pricelimit*ol.QtyOrdered END)::numeric,2) AS value FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id JOIN c_doctype dt ON o.c_doctypetarget_id=dt.c_doctype_id WHERE o.ad_client_id=1000026 AND o.processed='Y' AND o.isproposal='N' AND o.dateordered >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.dateordered < DATE '2026-04-01'
